rationale: The workshop sensor is correctly bound in both base and app, has good battery (75%), strong RSSI (-60 dBm, comparable to the working Front Door at -58 dBm), and compatible v3 firmware with no error codes. It was reset and held directly against the base station yet remains offline while all sibling sensors from the same box work, ruling out setup, signal, battery, and firmware issues and pointing to a hardware fault.

output.symptom_summary: Workshop Door sensor (SEN-D1) remains offline despite being bound in base and app, having good battery (75%), strong RSSI (-60 dBm), compatible v3 firmware, and being reset while held next to the base station. All other sensors from the same box work normally.
output.suspected_root_cause: Hardware fault in the Workshop Door sensor.

output.customer_reply: Thank you for your patience. Our diagnostics indicate a possible hardware issue with the workshop sensor. I have escalated your case to our engineering team, and they will contact you within 1-2 business days to arrange a replacement. We apologize for the inconvenience.
